ns0:svg.ns0:title: GNOSIS — Continual Agent Repair with Activation Boundaries
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Editable vector redraw of the supplied three-panel research diagram. Panel A shows continual repair, maturity verification, activation-bounded validation and release. Panel B shows local activation dependencies. Panel C shows global scope.

ns0:g.ns1:label: Panel A — Continual Repair and Release
